homePage.title: Full-stack Software Engineer
homePage.description: Hi, I'm Yago. This is my website, where I create simple things in super complicated ways just to prove I can. Explore my projects, check out my stack, and see what happens when I have free time and a text editor.

aboutMe.title: About Me
aboutMe.message: I'm Yago, I'm { age } and currently living in { address }. I specialize in turning coffee into code and, when I'm not messing with a dark-themed IDE, I also like playing guitar;reading books;coding;playing video games;watching movies and I'm definitely better at writing functions than biographies, so let's focus on technology.
aboutMe.experience: It all started at { age }, when I realized those 'colorful letters' on a black screen did cool things. Since then, I've been on a self-taught journey through the infinite vacuum of software development. Over the years, I swapped generic YouTube tutorials for complex documentation, gaining real experience across the entire stack. I learn fast, break things occasionally, but always fix them leaving them better than they were before.

skills.title: Skills
skills.description: My arsenal of languages and tools

frontend.title: Frontend Development
frontend.description: Creating pixel-perfect interfaces that look pretty even on Internet Explorer. I center divs and transform Figma designs into responsive and functional code.

backend.title: Backend Engineering
backend.description: The heavy lifting behind the scenes. I build scalable APIs, secure authentication flows and business logic that keeps the server from crashing on Friday afternoons.

devops.title: DevOps
devops.description: Taking code from 'localhost:3000' to the real world. I handle CI/CD pipelines, Docker containers, and AWS instances so that 'it works on my machine' becomes 'it works anywhere'.

database.title: Database Architecture
database.description: Structuring data efficiently so queries don't take 3 business days to run. Experience with SQL and NoSQL, and I promise never to run a DELETE without a WHERE.

quality.title: Code Quality
quality.description: Writing clean and sustainable code that my future self won't hate. I use automated tests, code reviews, and best practices to ensure the software doesn't break for no reason.
